mapper.sql: -- 窨井盖表字段 mc.id AS cover_id, mc.cover_no, -- 道路设施表字段 rf.id AS road_id, rf.road_name, -- 开合状态表字段 sos.id AS open_status_id, IFNULL(sos.status_name, '未配置状态') AS open_status_name, -- 监测表核心字段（数据库实际存在） mm.tilt_angle, mm.vibration_data, mm.risk_level_id, srl.level_name AS risk_level_name, mm.monitor_status, -- 设备表字段 sd.id AS device_id, IFNULL(sd.device_code, '未关联设备') AS device_code, IFNULL(sd.online_status, '未知状态') AS device_online_status, -- 运维人员字段 IFNULL(su.username, '未分配运维员') AS user_name, -- 配置表字段 IFNULL(mhc.collect_frequency, 0) AS collect_frequency, IFNULL(mhc.tilt_angle_threshold, 0.00) AS tilt_angle_threshold, -- 最后更新时间 mm.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT mc.id AS cover_id, mc.cover_no, rf.id AS road_id, rf.road_name, sos.id AS open_status_id, COALESCE(sos.status_name, '未配置状态') AS open_status_name, -- PostgreSQL替换IFNULL为COALESCE mm.tilt_angle, mm.vibration_data, mm.risk_level_id, COALESCE(srl.level_name, '未配置') AS risk_level_name, -- PostgreSQL替换IFNULL为COALESCE mm.monitor_status, sd.id AS device_id, COALESCE(sd.device_code, '未关联设备') AS device_code, -- PostgreSQL替换IFNULL为COALESCE COALESCE(sd.online_status, '未知状态') AS device_online_status,-- PostgreSQL替换IFNULL为COALESCE COALESCE(su.username, '未分配运维员') AS staff_name, -- PostgreSQL替换IFNULL为COALESCE COALESCE(mhc.collect_frequency, 0) AS collect_frequency, -- PostgreSQL替换IFNULL为COALESCE COALESCE(mhc.tilt_angle_threshold, 0.00) AS tilt_angle_threshold, -- PostgreSQL替换IFNULL为COALESCE TO_CHAR(mm.update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS update_time_str -- PostgreSQL替换DATE_FORMAT FROM munifacility.manhole_cover mc -- 补充模式前缀 INNER JOIN munifacility.manhole_monitor mm -- 补充模式前缀 ON mc.id = mm.cover_id AND mm.deleted = B'0' -- PostgreSQL bit类型判断 AND mc.tenant_id = 1 LEFT JOIN munifacility.road_facility rf -- 补充模式前缀 ON mc.road_id = rf.id AND rf.tenant_id = 1 LEFT JOIN munifacility.sys_open_status sos -- 补充模式前缀 ON mm.open_status_id = sos.id LEFT JOIN munifacility.sys_risk_level srl -- 补充模式前缀 ON mm.risk_level_id = srl.id LEFT JOIN munifacility.sys_device sd -- 补充模式前缀 ON mm.device_id = sd.id AND sd.tenant_id = 1 LEFT JOIN munifacility.sys_user su -- 补充模式前缀 ON mm.staff_id = su.id AND su.tenant_id = 1 LEFT JOIN munifacility.manhole_config mhc -- 补充模式前缀 ON mc.id = mhc.cover_id WHERE mc.id = #{coverId} AND mc.deleted = B'0' -- PostgreSQL bit类型判断 AND mc.tenant_id = 1

SELECT mc.id AS cover_id, mc.cover_no, rf.id AS road_id, rf.road_name, sos.id AS open_status_id, IFNULL(sos.status_name, '未配置状态') AS open_status_name, mm.tilt_angle, mm.vibration_data, mm.risk_level_id, IFNULL(srl.level_name, '未配置') AS risk_level_name, mm.monitor_status, sd.id AS device_id, IFNULL(sd.device_code, '未关联设备') AS device_code, IFNULL(sd.online_status, '未知状态') AS device_online_status, IFNULL(su.username, '未分配运维员') AS staff_name, IFNULL(mhc.collect_frequency, 0) AS collect_frequency, IFNULL(mhc.tilt_angle_threshold, 0.00) AS tilt_angle_threshold, DATE_FORMAT(mm.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS update_time_str FROM manhole_cover mc INNER JOIN manhole_monitor mm ON mc.id = mm.cover_id AND mm.deleted = 0 AND mc.tenant_id = 1 LEFT JOIN road_facility rf ON mc.road_id = rf.id AND rf.tenant_id = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_open_status sos ON mm.open_status_id = sos.id LEFT JOIN sys_risk_level srl ON mm.risk_level_id = srl.id LEFT JOIN sys_device sd ON mm.device_id = sd.id AND sd.tenant_id = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON mm.staff_id = su.id AND su.tenant_id = 1 LEFT JOIN manhole_config mhc ON mc.id = mhc.cover_id WHERE mc.cover_no = #{coverNo} AND mc.deleted = 0 AND mc.tenant_id = 1
